trailhead.label: Canazei (Piaz G. Marconi), the APT’s start

cautions: About 3.8 km on tarmac: village lanes and the valley cycle and foot path, shared with bikes.
Busy round the playgrounds and the river beach at Alba in summer.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
